title: Finite local stage lifts of a section of an etale sheaf colimit
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative ring. Let I be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], G : I → Sh(X_et, Mod_Λ) a diagram of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and c a colimit cocone with vertex H. Let U be an object of X_et whose underlying scheme is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let t ∈ H(U). There exist a finite index type B, a covering family f_b : V_b → U in X_et, with each underlying scheme of V_b ×_U V_b′ quasi-compact, a single object i ∈ I and sections s_b ∈ G_i(V_b) such that (c_i)_{V_b}(s_b) = t|_{V_b} for every b. The index type may be empty; no compatibility of the s_b on overlaps is claimed.

source.place: Tag 0738, proof of (4), finite local representatives before overlap equalization; etale finite refinements from literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, Tag 03Q4, Lemma 59.51.4 proof step 1

proof.text: Form the sectionwise presheaf colimit P and identify its module sheafification with H, respecting the coprojections, by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]. Local representability of sheafification [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] gives a covering and sections of P whose images are the restrictions of t.

By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation], every arrow of this covering is etale on underlying schemes. View it on the small etale site of U. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-qcqs-cofinal-finite-coverings] to obtain a finite affine refinement with quasi-compact pairwise scheme fibre products. Compose its structure maps with U to X to obtain objects V_b of the small etale site of X. The forgetful functor from this etale slice preserves these pullbacks, so the underlying schemes of the intrinsic pullbacks of f_b and f_b′ are isomorphic to the quasi-compact scheme fibre products, hence are compact.

Restrict each local presheaf representative along the refinement map. By the filtered module-colimit representative criterion (Concrete.colimit_exists_rep, with the ModuleCat filtered-colimit forgetful preservation instance; the set version is [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise]), each resulting section of P(V_b) comes from a section at some diagram stage i_b.

Filteredness supplies a common target i for the finitely many i_b (IsFiltered.sup_objs_exists). Transport all representatives to i. The colimit cocone equations show that their images still equal the restrictions of t. Reindex the finite covering by ULift of Fin n in universe u. In the empty-cover case choose any diagram object, which exists since the category is filtered, and use the empty family. No equality on overlaps and no global section at a diagram stage has been obtained.
